normal_and_ubsan_diagnostics: only expected pass markers; no compiler or sanitizer diagnostics

review_findings.arithmetic: Only invntt changed relative to EXP-002. The implementation equals the proposed function, retains twiddle order, all Montgomery operations, final factor 1441 and caller/downstream reductions. Internal representatives may differ modulo 3329; full tested KEM bytes agree.

bounds.condition: All current KEM inverse-transform inputs are centred by retained poly_reduce at the vector-dot-product exit. Arbitrary int16_t inputs or changed callers are not covered.

branch_dataflow_candidate.0x1b9: final-scaling pointer versus input base + 512 bytes
branch_dataflow_candidate.0x3f: public stage length compared with 16 at +0x3a

review_findings.decision: I accept EXP-003/RUN-0001 for incremental research timing against EXP-002 within the reviewed caller/compiler scope. Performance is not measured by this validation.
review_findings.footprint: For each parameter, inverse body grows 347 to 458 bytes; explicit stack reservation falls 56 to 24 bytes, six saved registers remain 48 bytes, and local use excluding entry return/callees falls 104 to 72 bytes. These are function-local observations, not whole-binary size or peak-stack measurements. Splitting loop bodies and changing register/spill/layout behaviour can affect timing along with removed Barrett calls.
review_findings.generated_control_flow: All three parameter sets have the same normalised reviewed instruction sequences after namespace substitution. GCC branches once per stage on public length == 16 and uses separate butterfly bodies. Other conditional branches test public counters, bounds or fixed pointer endpoints. Zeta and coefficient addresses derive from those counters and fixed offsets; coefficient values do not select paths or addresses in these bodies.
review_findings.hardening: Neither EXP-002 nor EXP-003 invntt contains a local stack-canary check; EXP-003 removes none here. endbr64 remains at entry. The earlier EXP-002 vector-function local-canary change persists in the unchanged source and remains part of the inherited security assessment. No protection flags were disabled.
review_findings.integer_representation: The generated code often loads coefficients with zero extension and uses low 16-bit add/sub results, then sign-extends before multiplication or Barrett. The proved signed bounds make these bit operations consistent with representable C values. Integer promotions and narrowing must be assessed explicitly; passing UBSan alone does not establish narrowing safety. Inherited signed narrowing/right-shift assumptions in reducers remain target-specific.
limits: 47 deterministic vectors per build are targeted samples, not exhaustive input coverage; the ordinary modular oracle shares the twiddle table and transform layout, so it tests arithmetic equivalence rather than independently establishing the complete specification.
The same fixture sets repeat across variants and normal/UBSan builds; counts, sanitizer and compatibility checks are separate evidence from speed.
Scoped assembly inspection is not a whole-program constant-time proof or statistical leakage test. Power/EM leakage, fault resistance and other compiler/target behaviour remain unassessed.
No claim of production approval, final ML-KEM conformance or universally optimal reduction schedule is established.
review_findings.next: I will rebuild accepted EXP-002 and EXP-003 with the same reviewed tools/flags and verify actual timing-build assembly before collecting matched pairs. Key generation has no predicted arithmetic benefit.
review_findings.reducer_calls: The EXP-003 inverse has one static Barrett site reached 128 times at length 16, and three static Montgomery sites for general-stage butterflies, length-16 butterflies and final scaling. Dynamic Montgomery calls remain 896+256=1152. EXP-002 has one Barrett and two Montgomery sites; dynamic Barrett calls were 896. Static sites are not dynamic counts.
review_findings.reducers: Montgomery (22 bytes) and Barrett (36 bytes) are instruction-identical between EXP-002 and EXP-003, with fixed multiply/add/subtract/shift sequences and no value-dependent branch, division or indirect call. The inspected invntt bodies also contain no division or indirect call.
